James Brennan · Client update

App messages on your Calls screen and texted sign-in codes are built; a verdict for every recording is next

External16 Oct 2026 03:34 to 17 Oct 2026 03:34 EDT24h

Messages from the technician app are built to show on your Calls screen as App calls, next to phone calls. That, texted sign-in codes and a sturdier path for app messages were finished and tested on Friday. We'll confirm each one on the live system before calling it done.

What the technician app gained

  • A technician signs in with a code texted to their phone.
  • If an app message fails partway, it's kept and finished later. It never claims a job report it didn't save, and one that can't be saved shows as failed, not stuck at "sending".

The harder part: a verdict for every recording

Until now, a recording could only match the caller's own jobs. Name another technician's job and the system couldn't see it; a recording with nothing to report left no trace. Now every recording from a technician's phone becomes a Calls row with one assessment: kind of call, summary, place, matched job and chemicals mentioned. Another technician's job is found and flagged as possibly misassigned. Our test phones never appear in your view.

Each job still gets one approval card, and nothing reaches GorillaDesk until you approve it. Older calls will read "Not assessed".

Where it stands

It works on our local test system, against a single test job. Next: our automated checks, a rehearsal on our separate test system, then release.

Updated 17 Oct 2026
report.markdown:
# App messages on your Calls screen and texted sign-in codes are built; a verdict for every recording is next

**Messages from the technician app are built to show on your Calls screen as App calls, next to phone calls.** That, texted sign-in codes and a sturdier path for app messages were finished and tested on Friday. We'll confirm each one on the live system before calling it done.

## What the technician app gained

- A technician signs in with a code texted to their phone.
- If an app message fails partway, it's kept and finished later. It never claims a job report it didn't save, and one that can't be saved shows as failed, not stuck at "sending".

## The harder part: a verdict for every recording

Until now, a recording could only match the caller's own jobs. Name another technician's job and the system couldn't see it; a recording with nothing to report left no trace. Now every recording from a technician's phone becomes a Calls row with one assessment: kind of call, summary, place, matched job and chemicals mentioned. Another technician's job is found and flagged as possibly misassigned. Our test phones never appear in your view.

Each job still gets one approval card, and nothing reaches GorillaDesk until you approve it. Older calls will read "Not assessed".

## Where it stands

It works on our local test system, against a single test job. Next: our automated checks, a rehearsal on our separate test system, then release.
